country.paper_says: The case of Ekiti State, Nigeria

study_design.paper_says: We explore this question using the case study research approach... questionnaire survey was administered... additional data were gathered from relevant literature and legal documents

population.paper_says: survey was administered to the senior staff members... existing water systems only served about 153 towns and communities compared with about 581 towns and communities in Ekiti State as of 2012

sample_size.paper_says: out of 52 that were purposively sampled, only 38 returned the completed questionnaires, representing about 73%

urban_rural.paper_says: had 19 urban towns... 45 small towns... and 517 rural communities

service_provider.paper_says: the Ekiti State Water Corporation Law No. 4 of 1997, CAP E36 establishes the Ekiti State Water Corporation (EKSWC)

regulatory_model.paper_says: factors were political interference, limited technical manpower, corruption, lack of government policy, lack of budgetary funding, and inadequate tariff recovery... analyzed against the Ekiti State Water Corporation Law No. 4 of 1997, CAP E36 and Ekiti State Public Procurement Law No. 2 of 2010

effect_measure.paper_says: The data obtained from the questionnaire survey were analysed manually using the comparative and thematic content approach... We define the major factors as those for which the number of respondents was larger than 15, representing about 40% of the respondents.

effect_estimate.paper_says: existing water systems only served about 153 towns and communities compared with about 581 towns and communities in Ekiti State... political interference represented the most major barrier... Ekiti State Water Corporation Law No. 4 of 1997, CAP E36... lacked provisions on implementation targets... budgetary allocations to piped water network extension were in the order 45 million Naira in 2018 and 50 million Naira in 2019... no funds were released

parsed.overall_comment: The first extractor accurately summarized the qualitative case study findings regarding barriers to piped water distribution network extension in Ekiti State, Nigeria.
